subject: One-time close sweetener for DeltaHealth pilot - credit & extension request
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@deltahealth.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Trial extension / credit to finish pilot?

Hi Ava,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the Redwood stack performed well against our latency and cost targets during the sample runs. We ran into a few edge cases in the last dataset pass and need an extra 2 weeks to finish the evaluation.

Would Redwood be open to a time-limited trial extension plus a small usage credit to cover the extra runs? If we can see the full evaluation through, we'll be in a position to convert to a dedicated seat and put a PO in front of you in Q1.

Ballpark: 14-day extension and ~$25k of credits applied toward the first invoice. Is that something you can put on paper?

Appreciate the flexibility — this is the final internal hurdle for us.

Best,
Samir Patel
Head of ML
DeltaHealth


From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@deltahealth.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T10:01:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Trial extension / credit to finish pilot?

Samir — thanks for the quick message and glad the runs looked promising. I can work with you on a written offer. Before I lock anything in, I'm looping in Ben and Marissa on the amount so we can get final sign-off.

Proposed (quick starting point):
- 14-day trial extension
- One-time $20,000 credit applied to the first paid invoice if DeltaHealth converts within 60 days of extension end
- Requirement: short technical review call at the end of the extension (we'll share a simple checklist)

I can push for $25k if there's urgency, but wanted to be transparent about the approval band. Ben/Marissa — would you be comfortable approving $20k as a standard close sweetener? If we want to stretch to $25k, I'll need a quick nod from finance for a one-off.

Samir, attaching a short MAP draft (DeltaHealth-MAP-v2.pdf) and a one-pager on SLA guardrails. I'll follow up as soon as I have internal confirmation.

Thanks — Ava
Ava Chen
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.com

Attachments: DeltaHealth-MAP-v2.pdf (proposal draft)

Subject: DeltaHealth - suggested close sweetener (need approval)

Ben / Marissa / Rafael — quick ask.

DeltaHealth (Samir) is requesting a 14-day extension + ~$25k credit to finish their pilot. They signal strong intent to convert to Dedicated/Reserved in Q1 if the extension covers the last validation checks.

My recommended terms:
- 14-day extension starting on confirmation
- One-time $22,500 credit (split the difference; signals motion without fully burning top-of-funnel $25k)
- Credit applied to first invoice if converted within 60 days post-extension
- Require a short post-trial review call (we own success path)

Rationale: they’re near the finish line and procurement has a strict calendar — this sweetener accelerates closure and secures a mid-sized commitment. I prefer the $22.5k band vs $20k given the timeline sensitivity.

Impact to revenue/finance: Rafael, can you confirm whether a $22.5k one-time credit is doable as an allowance against ARR for a one-off? If we need pre-approval, I can tighten to $20k.

HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890 (deal DH-2026-1103)

Thanks — Ava

Subject: Re: DeltaHealth - suggested close sweetener (need approval)

Ava — good call and thanks for the clear framing. I'm comfortable with an exception here. Approve up to $25,000 one-time credit given the acceleration value and high likelihood of conversion.

Rafael — please confirm billing flow: apply as a one-time credit to first invoice and mark credit code on the invoice so Revenue Ops can track. If there are any contract language tweaks (SLA/usage cap), ring me in.

Also: recommend we include the SLA brief as an appendix and get procurement to sign a short amendment acknowledging the conversion timeline.

- Legal: we'll issue a short amendment/addendum and apply the credit on the billing system (Rafael cc’d will attach the credit code).

Next steps:
1) Please confirm you want to start the extension on 11/23.
2) Nicole / procurement — I'll send an amendment for signature (DocuSign link below) and the MAP + SLA appendix attached.
3) We’ll schedule the post-trial review for the week after the extension ends.
